from speech_client import get_speech_client, normalize_response
from speech_models import create_streaming_config, create_audio_content

def stream_chunks(audio_generator):
    client = get_speech_client()
    streaming_config = create_streaming_config()
    requests = (types.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=audio_chunk) for audio_chunk in audio_generator)
    response = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, requests)
    return normalize_response(response)

from speech_client import get_speech_client
from speech_models import create_streaming_config

def stream_with_language(language_code='en-US'):
    client = get_speech_client()
    streaming_config = create_streaming_config(language_code=language_code)
    return client, streaming_config

from google.cloud import translate

def translate_text(text, target_language='es'):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums

def check_safety(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.types.Document(content=text, type=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    sentiment = analysis.document_sentiment.score
    return sentiment > -0.5

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums

def summarize_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.types.Document(content=text, type=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_entities(document=document)
    entities = [entity.name for entity in analysis.entities]
    return ' '.join(entities[:5])

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums

def embed_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.types.Document(content=text, type=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_entities(document=document)
    entities = [entity.name for entity in analysis.entities]
    return ' '.join(entities[:5])
